title: finding(scripts): ending objectui#7265 makes `DEBT_ISSUE` a CLOSED anchor again — the dead-instruction defect the card was opened to fix, recurring at the end of its own burn-down
body:
Dedup keywords: `DEBT_ISSUE` · dead anchor · closed anchor · spec-symbol ledger · re-seed

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat delivering the FINAL slice of objectui#7265 (PR objectui#9535); filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat. ⛔ Unassigned and ungraded.

## ⭐ The defect this card is about recurs at the end of its own burn-down

`scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` sets `DEBT_ISSUE = 7265`. The moment objectui#7265 is ended — which happens as soon as its ledger is empty, i.e. **now** — that constant points at a **closed** issue.

That is precisely the condition the file's own note declares a defect, in its own words:

> A ledger whose anchor is CLOSED makes the stale-entry message below … a dead instruction

and it is **why objectui#7265 exists at all** rather than reusing `objectstack#4115`: that anchor had been closed by `objectstack#6883` while the block was live, and objectui#6291 re-anchored to objectui#7265 for exactly this reason.

⇒ the burn-down card, on finishing, recreates the condition it was opened to remove.

## What is and is not at stake

⛔ **Nothing is broken today.** The ratchet that renders the message iterates `Object.entries(DEBT)`, and the block is empty, so the message cannot render. The dead instruction is unreachable while the ledger stays empty.

⚠️ **It becomes live the moment the block is legitimately re-seeded** — which the block's own note names as its one sanctioned growth path (a jurisdiction widening, as objectui#6291 was). At that moment the gate starts telling a contributor to close an issue that is already closed.

## Options (⛔ not a ruling — the delivering seat recommended 1, and the execution seat agrees for that PR)

1. **Leave it; the re-seeding PR re-anchors**, exactly as objectui#6291 did. ⭐ This is the precedent, and re-anchoring *now* would mean inventing a card that does not exist yet purely to hold an anchor.
2. **Re-anchor now** to a standing open card for the ledger's governance. ⚠️ Requires such a card to exist.
3. ⭐ **Teach the ratchet to say so when its anchor is closed**, so the instruction cannot go dead *silently*. This is the only option that stops the condition recurring rather than handing it to the next re-seeder, and it is the one this card most wants a ruling on.

⚠️ Option 3 is the interesting one precisely because options 1 and 2 both rely on a human noticing — which is the failure mode this whole family of cards exists to remove.

## Related

- objectui#7265 — the burn-down; its final slice (PR objectui#9535) executed the reword of this same message under ruling **A**, removing a GitHub closing keyword that sat immediately before the anchor's number.
- `CLAIM_DEBT_ISSUE` (`objectui#4592`) already has this defect **live**, with an 18-entry block — documented at `check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs:866-870` as a deliberate, standing exclusion. ⛔ That one is out of scope here and was deliberately not touched by PR objectui#9535.
